hypothesis: The observed analyst's narrow Docker progress filter reduces total Codex tokens for interpreting the retained pull result without losing required facts.
scope: Development diagnostic replay with explicit native-log completeness metadata in both arms. Same historical success log and two synthetic failure variants; not an independent validation or full coding task.

quality_gate: Every run reports recorded exit code, six pinned image digests, explicit incomplete source coverage, expected action and required diagnostic. All six runs must pass. Success diagnostic accepts truncated or incomplete wording.
acceptance: At least 10% lower pooled native total model tokens and all quality checks pass. Report every pair and every failure. Timing descriptive only. No statistical generalization.
accounting: Deduplicate native response IDs. Include all model input/output and fallback retrievals. Cached input is a subset, not extra. Record wall time, tool response bytes, compaction CPU time and raw hashes. Account for analyst/evaluation overhead separately; actual USD unknown.
execution: Fresh Codex session per cell, same prompt/tools/model/settings; sequential alternating order. One attempt per cell, no retries. Fixed recorded input; full raw retrieval available in both arms. Stop on ambiguous invocation. Captured model request/response pairs retained. Completeness metadata is identical in both arms; only progress-line presentation differs.
rollback: Do not enable filtering on any quality regression, missing original log, unknown format loss, or failure to meet the token gate. Keep the original logs.
